On the AIC page I read that you should bring all you submitted online in case they ask for it (ai would assume including the pictures and WhatsApp log): https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/

Out of curiosity, how long did it take you from submitting online application to getting the first appointment? My husband and I applied last week and trying to set our expectations on the timeline (it seems to vary so much from case to case 😖)
